meta.name: High-Performance Neuromorphic Auth Architecture
meta.description: Tactile 2.5D dual-light source design system with accessible contrast, zero-latency dark mode, and GSAP micro-interactions for InsForge authentication.

primary.role: Soft Royal Blue accent for focus rings, CTA gradients, active indicators

accent.role: Primary brand focus and glow highlight

neutral.usage: Dual-mode background with physical dual light source at 135deg

color.contrast_strategy: WCAG AA compliant (minimum 4.5:1). Dark slate text #1e293b on #f0f4f8 and bright slate #f8fafc on #1f1f2e

font_families.heading: var(--font-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
font_families.body: var(--font-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
font_families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: Clean geometric sans with crisp letter spacing for tactile digital readability

spacing.section_rhythm: Consistent 20px gap inside card, 32px padding on container

shape.border_usage: none to 1px subtle matching base highlight; depth comes from directional shadows

elevation.depth_cues: Dual shadows simulating top-left light source at 135deg with soft blur falloff

motion.easing: back.out(1.7) for tactile bounce; power2.out for parallax slips
motion.entrance_pattern: horizontal parallax slip with xPercent: 15, opacity: 0 -> 1, filter: blur(4px -> 0px)
motion.exit_pattern: horizontal parallax slip with xPercent: -15, opacity: 1 -> 0, filter: blur(0px -> 4px)
motion.philosophy: Tactile physical response with zero CLS and instant GPU memory cleanup

components.button_style: Tactile convex pill with onPointerDown 0.97 scale and inset shadow depression
components.input_style: Tactile inset well with deeper shadow on focus and soft royal blue focus ring
components.card_style: Floating 2.5D resting card with dual 135deg light/shadow cast and rounded-3xl corners
components.navigation_pattern: Tactile pill segmented control tab switcher with smooth sliding convex indicator
components.modal_style: Floating tactile surface with soft perimeter shadow
components.list_style: Inset well container with clean status items
components.component_notes: All inputs include screen-reader labels, pure SVG icons, clear validation feedback

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Sculpted physical matte surface reacting to light

visual_language.ornamentation: none (pure form through physical light physics)
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous and balanced for zero clutter
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: centered card with subtle ambient aura
visual_language.focal_strategy: clear single action focus with immediate tactile feedback

composition.hierarchy_method: spatial isolation and convex/concave depth planes
composition.balance_type: symmetric centered card with dynamic inline feedback
composition.flow_direction: vertical task flow with horizontal parallax view transitions
composition.grouping_strategy: contained field groupings with clear 12-16px gutters
composition.negative_space_role: creates calm focus, eliminating cognitive fatigue during login

imagery.graphic_elements: dual shadows, convex pill buttons, smooth progress meters

interaction_feel.feedback_style: physical tactile push (120ms to inset, spring back on release)
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: subtle elevation lift or smooth glow enhancement
interaction_feel.transition_personality: smooth horizontal parallax slips with motion blur
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: high responsiveness on every interactive boundary

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative (e.g., 'Sign In to Antigravity', 'Create Your Account')
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: clean prompt with tactile action button
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: constructive, specific, and actionable without blame

overview.fallback_strategy: CSS transition fallback when prefers-reduced-motion is active

background_effects.description: Subtle radial ambient illumination centered on card, shifting gently in dark/light mode

particle_systems.description: Disabled to guarantee zero CLS and maximum RAM savings on mobile devices

3d_elements.description: Simulated purely via 2.5D CSS dual box-shadows for 60fps performance

shader_effects.description: Not needed for low-RAM mobile performance

text_effects.description: Accessible crisp typography without CPU-draining text effects

cursor_effects.description: Default native cursor for accessibility and mobile compatibility

canvas_drawings.description: Pure CSS geometry to maximize battery life on mobile

svg_animations.description: Smooth SVG spinner and animated checkmark for auth states

visual_effects.composite_notes: Strict adherence to physical 135-degree dual lighting model. In light mode, highlights are pure white #ffffff and shadows are #d1d9e6 on #f0f4f8 base. In dark mode, highlights are #29293d and shadows are #15151f on #1f1f2e base. Micro-interactions utilize GSAP with gsap.context() lifecycle management ensuring zero RAM leaks on low-end mobile devices.
